C1391.title: Paras Jha Used Mirai Botnet to Attack Rutgers University
C1391.summary: From November 2014 through September 2016, former Rutgers University student Paras Jha repeatedly launched DDoS attacks against the university network. The attacks shut down the central authentication portal during multiple periods and disrupted access for students, faculty, and staff. The U.S. Department of Justice said some attacks occurred during exam periods and forced the university to incur additional response and DDoS-mitigation costs. Jha later pleaded guilty to related computer-crime charges.
